bill_cancel_reason_required.name: bill_cancel_reason_required
bill_cancel_reason_required.value: "bill"."status" <> 'cancelled' or ("bill"."cancel_reason" is not null and length(trim("bill"."cancel_reason")) > 0)

category_default_hsn_digits.name: category_default_hsn_digits
category_default_hsn_digits.value: "category"."default_hsn" is null or (length("category"."default_hsn") in (4, 6, 8) and "category"."default_hsn" not glob '*[^0-9]*')

item_variant_declared_pair.name: item_variant_declared_pair
item_variant_declared_pair.value: ("item_variant"."declared_qty_milli" is null and "item_variant"."declared_uom" is null) or ("item_variant"."declared_qty_milli" is not null and "item_variant"."declared_qty_milli" > 0 and "item_variant"."declared_uom" is not null)

movement_type_doc_rule.name: movement_type_doc_rule
movement_type_doc_rule.value: ("movement_type"."requires_doc" = 0 and "movement_type"."required_doc_type" is null) or ("movement_type"."requires_doc" = 1 and "movement_type"."required_doc_type" is not null)

exception_event_status_shape.name: exception_event_status_shape
exception_event_status_shape.value: ("exception_event"."status" = 'open' and "exception_event"."resolved_at" is null) or ("exception_event"."status" = 'resolved' and "exception_event"."resolved_at" is not null)

item_merge_log_action_shape.name: item_merge_log_action_shape
item_merge_log_action_shape.value: ("item_merge_log"."action" = 'merge' and "item_merge_log"."merge_log_id" is null and "item_merge_log"."reversible_until" is not null) or ("item_merge_log"."action" = 'reverse' and "item_merge_log"."merge_log_id" is not null and "item_merge_log"."reversible_until" is null)

tint_shade_labels_len.name: tint_shade_labels_len
tint_shade_labels_len.value: ("tint_shade"."customer_label" is null or length("tint_shade"."customer_label") <= 80) and ("tint_shade"."site_label" is null or length("tint_shade"."site_label") <= 80)

tint_shade_custom_labelled.name: tint_shade_custom_labelled
tint_shade_custom_labelled.value: "tint_shade"."source" = 'library' or "tint_shade"."customer_label" is not null or "tint_shade"."site_label" is not null

item_barcode_code_chars.name: item_barcode_code_chars
item_barcode_code_chars.value: length("item_barcode"."code") between 1 and 48 and "item_barcode"."code" not glob '*[^0-9A-Za-z-]*'
